items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever's best new enchantment has been quietly changed, leaving some casters on the back foot
items.description:
As World of Warcraft: Forever players dived into the game, they quickly discovered a specific weapon enchant that took area of effect spells to a whole other level. Sadly, with a sudden hotfix last night, this particular use case for the enchant has been removed.

items.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong devs announce a livestream for Friday, promise updates on the hotly-anticipated Sea of Sorrow DLC
items.description:
Hollow Knight: Silksong developer Team Cherry has announced it will host a 'Cherry Time Special Presentation' on 27th November, bringing more information to light about the game's first big DLC offering, Sea of Sorrows. We know that the free update will be nautically-themed - hence the eponymous 'sea' - and will feature new bosses, areas and so on, but other than that, information about what's coming is vague.

items.title: GTA 6 recompilers and vibe-coders implore AI chatbots to 'work faster' and 'make no mistakes' as they race to get the game running on PC
items.description:
Things continue to get messy in the community of players working on getting Grand Theft Auto 6 working on PC. The previous frontrunner, Project Leonida, got their Discord server and GitHub repository taken down by Rockstar, but others have seemingly stepped in to finish the job.

items.title: Blizzard is making a lot of the Diablo 4's event-specific Diablo 2 anniversary content permanent because everyone loved it in Season 15
items.description:
Blizzard has officially unveiled Diablo 4's next live-service season: Season of Tyrael's Gambit. This is the ARPG's 16th season, and it follows on from the popular and well-received Season of Hell's Legacy.

Read more

items.title: Players discover over 1,500 individual buildings you can enter in GTA 6, nearly 28% of all buildings on the map
items.description:
One GTA 6 player has put in the legwork and found that a shocking number of buildings across Leonida are freely accessible.

items.title: CD Projekt Red signs new marketing partnership deal with Sony for The Witcher 4, and to increase "the presence" of its games on PlayStation
items.description:
As part of The Witcher and Cyberpunk studio CD Projekt Red's recent Q3 earnings report, the developer offered some updates on upcoming game The Witcher 4.

items.title: Promising action-RPG, Showa American Story, has been delayed into late 2027 in order to feel "cohesive, responsive and complete" at launch
items.description:
Publisher 4Divinity and developer Nekcom Entertainment have announced that upcoming action-RPG Showa American Story will now launch on 28th October, 2027. This comes after various sites noticed a Steam page update that listed the game as launching in 2027, slipping from the previous, vague window that suggested the game would come out this year. The announcement was made on the developer's Twitter account.

items.title: Capcom's sci-fi dinosaur shooter Exoprimal is shutting down next year
items.description:
Sad news dinosaur lovers. Exoprimal - Capcom's third-person sci-fi shooter with a Jurassic twist - will be shutting down next year. With its closure, the game will no longer be playable, even for those who've got it downloaded.

Read more

items.title: Performance analysis reveals GTA 6 has a more stable frame-rate on Xbox Series X compared to PlayStation 5
items.description:
If you don't own a PlayStation 5 Pro, the best way to play Grand Theft Auto 6 is reportedly on Xbox Series X. That's according to new performance analysis, which shows Microsoft's console is more consistent at maintaining the game's 30fps frame-rate target than the base PS5.

Read more

items.title: Lords of the Fallen 2 delayed to April 2027, exact release date coming next month
items.description:
Lords of the Fallen 2 will now launch in April 2027, and we'll find out exactly when next month.

items.title: The Steam Awards turn 10 with throwback categories and a Game of the Year Hall of Fame
items.description:
Nominations for the 2026 Steam Awards are now open, and to mark the event's 10th anniversary, Valve has brought back some categories from years past and added a Hall of Fame.

items.title: You can expect a similar leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 as there is between GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt Red says
items.description:
CD Projekt Red has said people can expect a similar qualitative and technological leap from The Witcher 3 to The Witcher 4 as has been witnessed between Grand Theft Auto 5 and Grand Theft Auto 6.

category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past

items.title: GTA 6 launch knocked Call of Duty's daily players down 42 percent, Alinea estimates
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6's launch took a big bite out of Call of Duty’s player base, according to new estimates from Alinea Analytics, and four days on, it still hasn't recovered.

items.title: GTA 6 players are discovering, who needs a gun when it's easier to rob a store with a crate of beer?
items.description:
Guns might be the weapon of choice for most Grand Theft Auto 6 players, but it turns out some enterprising digital criminals are taking a more inventive approach to robberies. Who needs a gun by their side when you've got a crate of beer?

items.title: Remedy CEO praises Rockstar's support for the Max Payne 1 & 2 remake and respecting Remedy's creative vision
items.description:
Alan Wake and Control studio Remedy Entertainment is currently developing a highly-anticipated Max Payne 1 & 2 remake. The Finnish studio is doing so in partnership with Grand Theft Auto 6 studio Rockstar, which owns the IP and is funding the remake's development.

items.title: As Blizzard whacks one World of Warcraft: Forever gold farming exploit, it struggles to contain all of the alternatives popping up
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever is in the grip of a gold-farming bonanza, as Blizzard's attempts to curb them are met with a seemingly endless wave of alternative money-making methods.

items.title: Today's Nintendo Switch Online update finally introduces a feature players have been asking for since 2018
items.description:
There's been an exciting addition to the Nintendo Classics GameCube app today, as users have discovered a small - but oft-requested - change in the software's Version 2.2.0.

items.title: Unofficial GTA 6 PC port effort suffers setback as Rockstar seemingly takes down Project Leonida, one of the internet's biggest recompilation projects
items.description:
A lot has happened in the last 24 hours in the community working to get Grand Theft Auto 6 running on PC. And now, Rockstar has dealt a major blow to their efforts.

items.title: Rockstar is actively shopping Red Dead Redemption movie and TV rights around, just don't expect the same for Grand Theft Auto
items.description:
Rockstar Games is seemingly interested in expanding Red Dead Redemption beyond video games, after years of Hollywood knocking on its doors. According to a new report, the company is looking for someone to pick up the movie and TV rights for its open-world Westerner series.

items.title: GTA 6 players are already starting to get very good at heists, despite all the new challenges Rockstar has added to the game
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has been out for a little while now, and already players are showing off their skills when it comes to the game's many heists. Despite the challenges in getting away clean, some are proving it's possible.

items.title: More than 39 million people have played GTA 6 on PlayStation alone, Sony says, as the game breaks all-time player numbers on the platform
items.description:
Sony's revealed staggering statistics relating to the popularity of Grand Theft Auto on PlayStation 5, not least that more than 39 million unique people have played the game there. That's more than the official GTA 6 day-one sales tally of 32.5m copies across all platforms.

items.title: Rockstar Games reveals 23 extra tracks in GTA 6's deluxe edition soundtrack, featuring Denzel Curry, HEALTH, and more
items.description:
For those of you out there in love with Grand Theft Auto 6's soundtrack, you'll be happy to know that Rockstar Games have revealed an additional 23 tracks as part of the game's deluxe edition album.

Read more

items.title: Microsoft reportedly looked into killing paid multiplayer for next-gen Xbox Helix consoles
items.description:
A new report from Windows Central details how Xbox was reportedly looking into removing the paywall that prevents players without Xbox Live from playing online games, only to potentially renege on its decision sometime during production of the next-gen device.

Read more

items.title: Modders already have GTA 6 running on PC, after CyberLeek released a full Xbox build of the game
items.description:
A PC version of Grand Theft Auto 6 - one from unofficial sources, at least - may be closer than we thought. After suddenly returning last week with a near-full build of the Xbox version, notorious leaker CyberLeek has now posted the missing piece they intentionally held back: the game's executable (.exe) file.

items.title: Deltarune Chapter 6 is playable "from the beginning to the end," Toby Fox says, but the RPG's final part has "only just started"
items.description:
Toby Fox has given eager fans an update on the development of Deltarune Chapter 6 and Chapter 7 - the Undertale follow-up's final two episodes.

items.description:
Banjo-Kazooie - the iconic Rare platformer starring an absent-minded bear and the sassy red bird he carries in a backpack - has been on hiatus for years, but a new Activision job listing has raised hopes for a new game.

items.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
items.description:
After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series.

items.title: Dawn of War 4's newest trailer teases the appearance of a fan-favourite character in the game's post-launch DLC
items.description:
As Dawn of War 4's December release date inches ever closer, a new trailer appears to have teased a fan-favourite character's inclusion in the RTS's first post-launch DLC.

items.title: GTA 6 just got a patch that fixed a progression bug on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S
items.description:
Rockstar just issued a new patch for GTA 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, targeting a few issues players have been reporting since the game launched last Thursday (19th November).

items.title: Nvidia makes stunning decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
items.description:
Gaming tech giant Nvidia has decided to reinstate Jensen Huang as its president and CEO, despite allegedly saying it wouldn't, and despite a string of extramarital affairs and investigations into alleged bullying, workplace harassment, and humiliation.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 can run at 60fps on Xbox Series X if you use a glitch, but there's a catch
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 runs at 30 frames-per-second across all the consoles it's currently available on, including the more powerful PlayStation 5 Pro. The game doesn't offer a 60fps performance mode or an option to unlock the frame-rate, but one industrious player has managed to do it anyway on Xbox.

items.title: Metacritic's user review problem worsens, as GTA 6's launch prompts review-bombing for completely unrelated games like Soul Calibur and The Ocarina of Time
items.description:
In the wake of Grand Theft Auto 6's release and the wave of glowing reviews it received, a war is raging in Metacritic's user reviews, with some of the medium's best games of all time caught in the crossfire.

Read more
category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

items.title: Why can't you play darts in GTA 6 when you could in previous games? Because Rockstar "didn't have the resources" to do it to a standard it'd be happy with
items.description:
If you've been a fan of Grand Theft Auto for a while, you might have noticed a strange absence in GTA 6. While the game is packed full of different activities, the recurring pastime of darts is missing, having been present in GTA 5, GTA Online, and GTA 4.

Read more

items.title: Activision patents AI voice system that learns from in-game chat and creates audio for NPCs who can even speak in place of you
items.description:
Call of Duty publisher Activision has filed for a new patent allowing it to train NPCs on real-world player voice chat. The patent describes an AI-driven system that listens in on player voice chat following key gameplay moments and later recreates it using in-game characters.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6's strong and silent Jason was inspired by Steve McQueen and former Army Rangers, says Rockstar
items.description:
If you've noticed that Grand Theft Auto 6's Jason Duval isn't much of a talker, that's by design, as his quiet nature was inspired by Steve McQueen and the studio's research into former Army Rangers.

Read more

items.title: Binding of Isaac dev pulls AI-generated music from Repentance+ after players expose it
items.description:
Nicalis has removed AI-generated music from The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players discovered it in the game's latest update, prompting a wave of negative reviews on Steam.

Read more

items.title: Over half of all console players active on GTA 6's launch day played it, says Circana
items.description:
On Grand Theft Auto 6's launch day, more than half of everyone playing on PS5 and Xbox was playing GTA 6.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 player gets 30-day PSN ban for sharing in-game nudist photo with a friend
items.description:
A Grand Theft Auto 6 player says they've been hit with a 30-day PlayStation Network social features ban after sending a friend a photo they took in the game's nudist resort.

Read more

items.title: Unannounced Nioh 3 Complete Edition has been rated in Korea
items.description:
A rating for the unannounced Nioh 3 Complete Edition has popped up on Korea's Game Rating and Administration Committee (GRAC).

items.title: Phasmophobia's next update lets you ask ghosts to throw things and it's out next week
items.description:
Phasmophobia's next update, Resonance, arrives on 24th November, bringing a brand-new piece of ghost-hunting kit, more voice commands, and a move to the Unity 6 engine.

items.title: GTA 6 is crashing on some PS5s with error CE-108255-1 - here's what you can try
items.description:
Some Grand Theft Auto 6 players on PS5 say the game keeps crashing with error code CE-108255-1, and in some cases, it's stopping them from progressing through the story.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 has a 99 Metascore from critics, but players are review bombing it
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 might be one of the best-reviewed games of all time, but you wouldn't know it from its Metacritic user score.

items.title: GTA 6 features the series' first non-binary character, says actor Jesse James Rose, and players can't hurt them
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 features the first non-binary character in the series' history, according to actor Jesse James Rose, who plays the role of a museum curator in the game.

items.title: GTA 6 is officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, selling 32.5 million pre-sale copies and a bonkers $3.79 billion in its first day
items.description:
Surprise, surprise - GTA 6 is officially the biggest entertainment launch of all time, surpassing its predecessor's 13-year-long record and the already optimistic analyst estimates.

Read more

items.title: After taking seven years to make Persona 6 and four years to make Persona 5, Atlus promises future games will come quicker
items.description:
Persona 6 is still slowly chugging in the background, but developer Atlus is promising that future games in its beloved RPG series won't take quite as long as they used to.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 credits actually include 'Florida Joker', the viral internet personality who once demanded $10 million from Rockstar Games
items.description:
Lawrence Sullivan, better known to the online world as the 'Florida Joker', is in GTA 6. After accusing Rockstar Games of using his likeness without consent and then demanding a $10m payout, the two parties have seemingly settled their differences.

Read more

items.title: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang accused of decades of bullying and workplace abuse in new investigation
items.description:
An investigation into the workplace behavior of Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang, who resigned recently after a series of extramarital affairs came to light, has uncovered decades of harassment, verbal employee abuse and "cultish" behaviour at the company which has long played a major role in PC gaming.

Read more

items.title: 13 arrested in Shanghai as police crackdown on bootleg Final Fantasy 7 Tifa figurine operation
items.description:
Chinese police have arrested 13 individuals in Shanghai allegedly involved in a bootleg Final Fantasy 7 Tifa figurine business, after consumers reported the operation. They are currently being investigated on suspicion of selling infringing reproductions.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 players are already pulling off high-flying tricks and other impressive stunts, just days after launch
items.description:
One of the best things to emerge from Grand Theft Auto over the years has been the community's truly spectacular stunts: players soaring under bridges, leaping across buildings, and more. And with GTA 6's release this week, we've seen the first signs of the trend continuing in a brand-new world.

Read more

items.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer studio "didn't dream" Biddy Blas would be as popular as he is
items.description:
Fuse Games, the developer of Star Wars: Galactic Racer, has said it "didn't dream" the pod racing game's background character Biddy Blas would become as popular as he has.

Read more

items.title: UK Prime Minister won't be playing GTA 6, government says, while hailing Rockstar Games a "British success story"
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6's seismic launch has registered on a governmental level. A spokesperson for UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has hailed the game as a "British success story", but confirmed Burnham himself won't be playing it. His diary is apparently "very full".

Read more

items.title: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 breaks the game into star system mini-campaigns, each with their own stories and objectives
items.description:
There is perhaps nothing so brutal in a Total War game than getting an army full of elite units wiped out, and it appears that pain remains a factor in the upcoming Total War conversion of : Warhammer 40,000. Creative Assembly also has some nifty ideas around breaking the game into mini-campaigns for each star system you visit.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 day-one sales are enormous, estimates suggest, making previous $2 billion opening weekend predictions seem conservative
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is estimated to have sold nearly 25 million copies in one day, generating approximately $2.5bn in sales revenue - a staggering result that's beyond even what even observers were predicting.

Read more

items.title: "You broke my heart" - popular artist Doja Cat gutted to not have her music in Grand Theft Auto 6
items.description:
As countless people flock to Grand Theft Auto 6 following its launch earlier this week, a common highlight gamers have been highlighting are the many radio stations present in the game. While packed with songs, one artist has expressed her frustration with not being included among the list of featured artists.

Read more

items.title: Blizzard wants to "get rid" of best-in-slot items in World of Warcraft: Forever by introducing situationally strong gear
items.description:
With World of Warcraft: Forever's first raids set to release in early December, developers of the game have spoken about endgame itemisation and their desire to disrupt the "best-in-slot" (BIS) mindset that's been at the core of WoW's progression for years.

Read more

items.title: Ubisoft says Assassin's Creed Jade is still alive as it merges two of its Creative Houses
items.description:
Ubisoft has confirmed that while Assassin's Creed Jade - its mobile entry in the series - is still in development, its focus remains with console and PC.

Read more

items.title: Infamous GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek is back, and this time the group claims to have leaked a full development build of the game
items.description:
CyberLeek, the persona of a hacker group that was responsible for leaking GTA 6 gameplay before the game launched, has reappeared today, claiming to have released a development build of the final version of the game on its site. This new leak appears to be making good on a threat posted back in October, where the group stated its intent to release a full, playable build of the game.

Read more

items.title: World of Warcraft: Forever has more weekly players than WoW has seen in 15 years, says Blizzard
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever now has more people playing each week than World of Warcraft has seen in 15 years, according to Blizzard.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 players are being abducted by aliens and knocked out by Bigfoot
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has only been out for a matter of hours, and players have already tracked down a UFO in the woods and a Bigfoot in the swamps.

Read more

items.title: Ubisoft cuts jobs at major Assassin's Creed and Far Cry studios as its year of layoffs continues
items.description:
Ubisoft has confirmed more layoffs as part of its previously announced operational "reset", this time affecting 166 employees at its major Montréal and Québec City studios - the teams responsible for game series including Assassin's Creed and Far Cry. It says the cuts are necessary "to ensure our resources are aligned with current production priorities and business needs."

Read more

items.title: Over 2 million Xbox players in the UK and US reportedly used the 'New Zealand trick' to play GTA 6 early - that's more than a third of the country's population
items.description:
We already knew there'd be a frantic clamour for GTA 6 this week, and we also knew plenty of players would be eyeing up Xbox's 'New Zealand trick' to get in on the action early. But it's now being reported that a whopping 2m UK and US players took advantage of the trick - which, for context, equals more than a third of New Zealand's actual population.

Read more

items.title: Rockstar reveals full GTA 6 cast list, finally ending speculation about who plays Jason Duval in the game
items.description:
UPDATE 5PM GMT: Actors Manni L. Perez and Dylan Rourke have announced their involvement in GTA 6, in portraying Lucia and Jason, respectively, in the game.

Read more

items.title: Does GTA 6 have an 'easy mode'? Not officially, but there are two very important settings you can change to make the game less difficult
items.description:
By now, you've probably heard that you cannot use cheats in GTA 6 until you complete the main story. Not only that, but enabling cheat codes also locks story progression and deactivates the ability to save. Basically, you can use cheats to have a quick crime spree and blow off some steam, then it's back to normalcy. Understandably, some gamers are a little put out with this change.

Read more

items.title: Warren Spector lambasts GTA 6's "billion dollar" development - 'I just hope it's is the last of its kind even if it's the best we have to offer'
items.description:
As GTA 6 finally arrives, increasingly outspoken games industry legend Warren Spector - known for seminal immersive sims including Deus Ex - has offered both praise for the game's achievements and lambasted its "billion dollar" development model, writing, "I just hope GTA 6 is the last of its kind even if it’s the best we have to offer".

Read more

items.title: As Rockstar's alleged "union busting" tribunal hearing comes to a close amid GTA 6 launch, judge pledges to deliver verdict "as quickly as I possibly can"
items.description:
Closing statements in Rockstar and IWGB's employment tribunal case - revolving around the GTA 6 developer's alleged 'union busting' and the firing of 34 employees - have now been read, bringing the hearing to an end. There's currently no timeline for a verdict, however, with one commentator suggesting a judgement could take weeks or months to arrive.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 was October's biggest game in the US, but it wasn't enough to crack 2026's best-selling top 10
items.description:
Despite its somewhat muted critical reception, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has predictably topped the US video game charts in October. The Infinity Ward-developed shooter was October's best-selling game in the US across digital and retail, beating the month's other big-hitters, including Gears of War: E-Day and Star Wars: Galactic Racer.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 has replaced websites with social media and phone apps because "it didn't feel necessary"
items.description:
The internet of today is a far cry from the days when Grand Theft Auto 5 was released, which is partly why Rockstar didn't bring back its own satirical version of the web in GTA 6.

Read more

items.title: GameStop CEO slams 'code-in-a-box' games in the wake of GTA 6's discless release
items.description:
Ryan Cohen, CEO of GameStop - the self-proclaimed "world's largest retail gaming and trade-in destination" - is not happy with the emerging trend of games releasing without discs. Per the CEO, the industry's move away from physical games and towards a digital-only future is harmful to both consumers and businesses.

Read more

items.title: The hunt for World of Warcraft: Forever secrets continue with the discovery of an elusive pet
items.description:
The search for secrets in World of Warcraft: Forever continues ever onwards, with a new breakthrough coming to light in recent days. The latest discovery? An elusive new cat that can be tamed by hunters in one of the game's new zones.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 developers at Rockstar are worried about being laid off after shipping "the biggest game of all time"
items.description:
Rockstar has successfully shipped Grand Theft Auto 6, after years of work and more than a billion dollars spent. GTA 6 is already one of the highest-rated games ever - Eurogamer awarded it five stars in our GTA 6 review - and it's expected to be among the most successful, best-selling games ever.

Read more

items.title: After Grand Theft Auto 6's launch, players are in love with wacky criminality, in-game social media, and animal fatalities
items.description:
With Grand Theft Auto 6 launching late last night (unless you're in New Zealand, in-person or otherwise), players have been flocking to online spaces to share their favourite moments. So far, slapstick violence, animal fatalities, and the in-game social media have won the hearts of many.

Read more

items.title: It really seems like Xbox isn't allowed to say GTA 6 at all
items.description:
Like many major brands, Xbox is finding all sorts of ways to associate with the biggest game launch of the year: Grand Theft Auto 6. Unlike indie publisher Devolver Digital, however, Xbox has cleverly avoided ever mentioning GTA 6 directly in its marketing campaigns for GTA 6.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6's Japanese version only partially obscures male nudity by putting Jason in a thong, seemingly due to regional censorship
items.description:
GTA 6 is slowly rolling out across the globe. The crime epic's already available to play in countries such as South Korea and New Zealand, but Japanese players are finding out that male nudity is only partially obscured by a thin black thong that covers Jason and the other men in Leonida.

Read more

items.title: Delete GTA 6 from your hard drive and indie publisher Devolver Digital might give you a free game
items.description:
GTA 6 is out at midnight everywhere (19th November), but it's far from the only game in town. Indie publisher Devolver Digital is taking on the open-world behemoth with its very own Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, out the same day, and you can win a free copy of the platformer by proving you've deleted GTA 6 off your hard drive.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 won't let you use cheats until you complete the main story, and locks progression when you do
items.description:
Here's a twist: you can't use cheats in Grand Theft Auto 6 until you complete the entire game's main story.

Read more

items.title: Even the PS5 Pro is "not powerful enough" to run GTA 6 at 60FPS or 40FPS, Rockstar says
items.description:
Don't expect GTA 6 to get an update supporting higher framerate modes, at least, not on current-generation consoles. Rockstar has explained that even the most powerful console of the bunch, the PS5 Pro, isn't powerful enough to run the lavish game at 40FPS or 60FPS.

Read more

items.title: PSA: Some GTA 6 Ultimate Edition content is only available for the first chapter, and you'll have to put in hard graft to unlock more
items.description:
GTA 6's Ultimate Edition has proven enormously popular, despite its hefty $100 price tag. So much so that Strauss Zelnick, boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, recently confirmed it's the edition most people are buying - and that's despite a lack of specific information about how its unlockable content works. With GTA 6 just hours away from release, however - and out now in certain parts of the work - details are beginning to emerge, and the answer is perhaps a little surprising.

Read more

items.title: All 34 of the infamously fired Rockstar staff appear in GTA 6 game credits, though some aren't listed as "former employees", curiously
items.description:
UPDATE 19TH NOVEMBER: All of the 34 fired Rockstar employees appear in the credits for GTA 6. We were able to confirm the final few names' existence there after Rockstar posted the full credits online - in searchable form. Before this, the process of cross-checking was intensely laborious: it required watching a scrolling list of names for an hour-and-a-half to see if they appeared.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 is so big, it managed to break Reddit - and it isn't even actually out yet
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 isn't even out yet, and it's already causing some technical issues over at the game's official Reddit page.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 breaks the all-time livestream viewer record hours before it's  available to play for most of the world
items.description:
Hours before it's even playable in most of the world, Grand Theft Auto 6 has already broken the record for the most viewers across livestreaming platforms like Twitch.

Read more

items.title: PlayStation has no Game of the Year nominations at The Game Awards for the first time in 11 years
items.description:
Last night, The Game Awards 2026 nominations were officially announced, and fans immediately noticed the prestigious Game of the Year category - previously won by the likes of Astro Bot, Clair Obscur, and Elden Ring - does not feature a PlayStation-published game this year. It's a rare sight for PlayStation Studios, which has secured a Game of the Year nomination every year since 2015.

Read more

items.title: Just how detailed is the audio in GTA 6? Well, even convenience store refrigerators "all have their own unique sounds", says Rockstar dev
items.description:
If you've been online at all today, you'll know that what feels like the entire world is currently fawning over GTA 6. As the reviews dropped, one thing quickly became very clear: this is a game absolutely packed with detail. Our own Chris noted that, thanks to this focus on specific detail and unbelievable nuance, Grand Theft Auto 6 is "the most unbelievable video game world ever made". And it's no accident: this is something Rockstar put a lot of dedicated effort into.

Read more

items.title: You cannot replay missions in GTA 6, but you can use multiple save files, as Rockstar explains how it made missions "harder to fail"
items.description:
You cannot replay GTA 6 missions again once you've completed them. This might be a shock to some people, since the option to do so was included in Rockstar games as recently as GTA 5, but here once you've made progress in the story, that's it. Our reviewer confirmed this in his 100+ hour playthrough of the title.

Read more

items.title: Infinity Nikki fans threaten to boycott game after promotion by Elon Musk's mother, but there may be a genuine reason for her involvement
items.description:
Infinity Nikki, the free-to-play, cozy, open-world dress-up game, is at the centre of controversy again, though this time not because fans disliked one of the game's updates. Instead, it's because of… Elon Musk's mother.

Read more

items.title: Mindseye developer Build a Rocket Boy - founded by ex-GTA veteran - has a mountain of debt, and the main plan for paying it back is litigation
items.description:
Beleaguered Mindseye developer Build a Rocket Boy - the company created by former Rockstar and Grand Theft Auto producer Leslie Benzies - apparently owes approximately £62 million in debt. And a huge chunk of that appears to be owed to Chinese gaming company NetEase (£36.5m), though more than £1m appears to be owed to Benzies himself.

Read more

items.title: Clair Obscur's narrative lead has left developer Sandfall Interactive after "wrapping up some final stuff for Expedition"
items.description:
Last night, it was revealed that Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's lead narrative designer, Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, won a BAFTA Breakthrough US award for her contribution to the hit 2025 game, which made history after winning 12 Game Award nominations last year. In the aftermath of her win, Svedberg-Yen dropped a pretty big bombshell: she's no longer with the game's developer, Sandfall Interactive.

Read more

items.title: Slay the Spire 2 is one of this year's best selling games despite only being available on PC, and its players are "obsessed"
items.description:
One million copies for each month on sale, it seems. Slay the Spire 2, Mega Crit's roguelike deckbuilder, is estimated to have sold 7.9m copies since its release in Steam Early Access in March.

Read more

items.title: "We'd love to have you" - New Zealand's tourist board gives a nod to those hopping timezones to play Grand Theft Auto 6 early
items.description:
New Zealand's tourism board has taken advantage of all the excitement surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6's launch, as hordes of players who've changed their Xbox timezones to that of the world's second best rugby team (sorry) to jump into the game early.

Read more

items.title: Blizzard suspends World of Warcraft: Forever gold exploit abusers, puts trading blocks on their accounts and removes ill-gotten funds for good measure
items.description:
Players who abused World of Warcraft: Forever's Blackmaw Hold unintended gold farm, which allowed a small minority of players to hoard thousands of gold in a few days, have drawn the ire of WoW publisher, Blizzard. Suspensions have been issued, trade locks have been put on accounts, and ill-gotten gold is being seized.

Read more

items.title: Former GTA 4 and Red Dead boss thinks "we are one Toy Story moment away" from people accepting gen-AI in game development in the West
items.description:
Ben Feder, the former Take-Two CEO who oversaw the launch of massive hits like Grand Theft Auto 4, Red Dead Redemption, Borderlands, and BioShock during his tenure, believes the resistance against gen-AI in games will vanish once the games industry has its 'Toy Story moment'.

Read more

items.title: The Game Awards 2026 nominees announced, and GTA 6 leads with eight nods before it's even out
items.description:
The Game Awards 2026 nominees have been revealed, and Grand Theft Auto 6 leads the pack with eight nominations, two days before it even launches.

items.title: Firaxis reportedly cuts a third of its staff as studio head departs and new XCOM struggles
items.description:
Update 22nd November: A WARN notice filed in Maryland, where Firaxis is headquartered, shows that 37 employees based at the studio's Hunt Valley office have been laid off.

items.title: The Game Awards just confirmed who plays GTA 6's Lucia
items.description:
Manni L. Perez has been confirmed as the actress behind Grand Theft Auto 6's Lucia Caminos, just days before the game launches.

Read more

items.title: PlayStation defeats £2 billion UK lawsuit that alleged Sony forced consumers into "excessive and unfair prices"
items.description:
Sony has defeated a major £2 billion UK class action lawsuit concerning the price of games on the PlayStation Store (thanks, TheGameBusiness). The judgment came after a 30-day Competition Appeal Tribunal that took place in London, where PlayStation users claimed Sony had removed "all actual and potential competition" in relation to selling digital games on the console.

Read more

items.title: Sci-fi RPG Exodus continues evoking Mass Effect by revealing female lead and nicknaming her FemJun
items.description:
Sci-fi role-playing game Exodus continues to play into the Mass Effect comparisons by revealing the female version of its main character Jun, and with studio Archetype referring to her in marketing material as FemJun.

Read more

items.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 is the US' best-selling physical game so far this year
items.description:
The very popular and critically-acclaimed The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has set another record. After selling 5.2m copies in four days and becoming the Switch 2's fastest-selling game, Ocarina of Time has now been revealed to also be a major seller at retail.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty might have swapped guns and tanks for knights and swords if an Infinity Ward experiment had panned out
items.description:
As much as Call of Duty is criticised for delivering the same thing every year, reports occasionally surface of attempts to take the series in bold new directions, even if none of these experiments have so far seen the light of day. And it turns out a medieval Call of Duty was also explored at one time.

Read more

items.title: Is it time to retire Dragon Quest as a series? Chrono Trigger composer Yasunori Mitsuda thinks it might be
items.description:
Chrono Trigger composer Yasunori Mitsuda thinks it may be time for Square Enix to retire Dragon Quest, while reflecting on the direction of the popular RPG series after Akira Toriyama's death. The mangaka, whose art and distinct style were foundational to Chrono Trigger and Chrono Cross - and are still used in Dragon Quest to this day - died in 2024 at the age of 68.

Read more
category: Dragon Quest XII: The Flames Of Fate

items.title: "Encouraging players to return is no mean feat" - Square Enix tempts Final Fantasy 14 players back with free game-time to fill void before new expansion
items.description:
Final Fantasy 14 is between expansions at the moment, with Evercold preparing for release in February. So, in order to keep the game populated for the next few months, Square Enix is running a special promotion in hopes of tempting players back in.

Read more

items.title: After GTA 6's original soundtrack, Justice probably won't work on any other video game ever again
items.description:
You've probably heard at least a little bit of the Grand Theft Auto 6 soundtrack from French electronic duo, Justice: a single taken from the act's original soundtrack has been released as a standalone track, and was the accompaniment to GTA 6's launch trailer. Featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and the fantastic King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard, it's clear that the duo - and Rockstar - have spared no expense on the production of music for the game.

Read more
